workflow.name: ChronicleAI Uniswap V3 USDC/WETH Large Swap Monitor (Telegram bridge)
workflow.description: NEWSPAPER ONLY (not a desk execution input). FREE TIER: Schedule hourly (~720 schedule fires/mo; For Each can add more) → Query Swap events → size filter (~$500k+) → Telegram CHRONICLE_INGEST. Prefer a separate vanity account or leave disabled. Desk strategies use Sepolia desk-*-poll workflows instead. Set chatId to TELEGRAM_INGEST_CHAT_ID.

config.condition: ({{@for-each-swap:For Each Swap.currentItem.args.amount0}} >= 500000000000 || {{@for-each-swap:For Each Swap.currentItem.args.amount0}} <= -500000000000) || ({{@for-each-swap:For Each Swap.currentItem.args.amount1}} >= 200000000000000000000 || {{@for-each-swap:For Each Swap.currentItem.args.amount1}} <= -200000000000000000000)
